label: Singapore crisis and rebound blocks; calendar-defined sensitivity

events.label: Dot-com slowdown through SARS; broad combined block
COVID and reopening block retained from existing convention

strict_growth_window_rule: For outcome date t, require every calendar period from t-h through t inclusive to be outside the event blocks; h=4 quarters or12 months. Use the SAME resulting YoY-safe dates for all five outcomes within each context.
event_dates_rule: Only the observation date t must be outside the event blocks; this can retain affected YoY denominators and is labelled as such.
invariants: Compute growth/lags from full source history BEFORE exclusions.
Never select or delete observations by realised growth, residual size, p-values, or stationarity test outcomes.
Preserve actual calendar gaps in HAC lag distances.
Use exact parent eligibility and common dates across outcomes within each context.
Different taxonomy/history contexts remain explicit; matched broad/detail comparisons use identical dates.
One-sector regressions retain calendar HAC; pooled common slopes retain requested sector CR1 alongside DK; sector-specific total effects retain joint DK.
interpretation: These intentionally broad event/rebound blocks are an analysis choice, not an official recession-dating series, an exhaustive list of every sectoral shock, or a claim all unusual growth has been removed. The resulting non-crisis estimates are sensitivity analyses, not causal certification.
